(2) The scene shifts to a white shoe cabinet where the woman points out a significant misalignment in the cabinet doors. She demonstrates the poor build quality by touching the uneven edges and gaps. The background remains a clean, brightly lit modern apartment hallway with a bag and decorative items on top of the cabinet. (3) In a kitchen setting, the woman stands beside a multi-tiered wooden cabinet filled with various snack packages and a microwave. She opens a wooden-handled drawer to highlight that it lacks sliding rails, pointing at the fixed support structure. A silver refrigerator and kitchen counter items are visible in the background. (4) The woman kneels on a light-colored rug in front of a white TV console in the living room. She pushes a cabinet door closed to demonstrate a soft-close hinge mechanism. A large flat-screen TV and various small figurines, including a green retro TV toy, are displayed on the console. (5) Standing next to a black metal shelving unit illuminated by pink and purple LED backlighting, the woman showcases various crystals and collectibles. She uses her hands to indicate the size and placement of the items. The room is brightly lit with high-contrast, vibrant colors from the LED strips. (6) In a walk-in closet area, the woman presents a large black metal wardrobe system filled with an array of hanging garments. She pulls out a wooden drawer to show its construction and the organized contents inside. The environment is dense with textures from different fabrics and storage bins. (7) The woman returns to a standing position in the closet area, facing the camera to summarize her furniture review. She uses expressive hand gestures to emphasize her points, surrounded by the open wardrobe system and domestic storage elements in a bright, natural-toned room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a friendly female voice narrating in Mandarin Chinese over a steady, upbeat acoustic guitar melody. The speech is clear and well-articulated, while the music maintains a consistent 100 BPM tempo. A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the introduction. (2) A distinct 'ding' SFX marks the start of the first cabinet review. The speaker's tone becomes more critical as she points out defects. A metallic 'click' followed by a dull 'thud' is heard as she manipulates the cabinet door to show the misalignment. (3) The vocal tone shifts to a neutral narrative style while the acoustic BGM continues with light percussion. A sharp mechanical sliding sound occurs as she opens a kitchen drawer, followed by a percussive impact against the wood frame, highlighting the lack of rails. (4) The speaker's voice becomes more satisfied and appreciative. A subtle transition 'whoosh' is heard. This phase features a muffled, soft 'thud' sound as a cabinet door is pushed shut, audibly demonstrating the soft-close hinge mechanism in the living room. (5) High-frequency tapping sounds occur as the woman interacts with crystals on a metal shelf. The acoustic guitar BGM remains constant. Her vocal delivery is energetic and enthusiastic, emphasizing the aesthetic value of the illuminated display case. (6) The narration becomes more authoritative and descriptive. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo. A series of percussive wooden sliding thuds and mechanical clicks are heard as she demonstrates the wardrobe system's drawers and the stability of the metal frame. (7) The video concludes with a warm, encouraging vocal tone summarizing the overall experience. The acoustic BGM continues until a final 'ding' sound effect signifies the end of the review, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout the track.
